net-ionic-equation.def: An equation for a reaction in solution that shows only the species that change. The molecular equation writes whole formulas; the complete ionic equation splits every dissolved ionic compound into ions; removing the spectator ions gives the net ionic equation.

spectator-ion.def: An ion that is dissolved and unchanged on both sides of a reaction in solution, so it is left out of the net ionic equation.

precipitate.def: An insoluble solid that forms when solutions are mixed; precipitation is the forming of that solid.
